programme.title: Bhadrakaali
programme.desc: A man who seeks justice opposes a tyrannical dominion to inspire widespread dissent among the oppressed masses. Consequently, the brave man triggers immediate retaliation.

programme.title: Sundara Kanda
programme.desc: A newly appointed professor finds that his student has a crush on him and wants to marry him. However, he ignores her advances and marries an orphan, but she continues to pursue him.

programme.title: Udumba
programme.desc: An orphan lives a carefree life as he spends time with his lady-love and friends. However, his world comes crashing down after he learns the truth about his past.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Bhumi Rakshak
programme.desc: Two half-brothers peacefully co-exist with each other and their families. However, the return of an old enemy threatens the unity of the close-knit family.

programme.title: Dum Man Of Power
programme.desc: A fun-loving Abhiram crosses paths with a timid Uma during a European trip. Before they could express their love for each other, they part ways.

programme.title: Anjala
programme.desc: The members of a family join hands to save their ancestral tea shop from being demolished, even after receiving threats from the government.

programme.title: The Return of Abhimanyu
programme.desc: A soldier uses fake papers to borrow money from the bank for his sister's marriage. When the loan money goes missing from his account, he sets out to hunt down those who stole from him.

programme.title: Pichaikkaran 2
programme.desc: Sathya is a poor man in search of his sister, who has been kidnapped by human traffickers. However, an illegal brain transplant puts him in the shoes of a billionaire named Vijay.

programme.title: OMG Oh My God
programme.desc: After Kanji, an atheist, loses his shop in an earthquake, he decides to sue God. Later, society condemns him for his blasphemy, while Lord Krishna himself becomes Kanji's saviour.

programme.title: Jigar Kaleja
programme.desc: A short-tempered cab driver, Raju, unwillingly becomes the saviour of a village. When an industrialist tries to drive away the villagers by polluting their water and air, Raju steps up to help them.

programme.title: Devara: Part 1
programme.desc: A fierce sea warrior violently opposes his village's criminal activities, while years later, his gentle son charts his own course, creating a stark contrast in paths.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A meek man, Devdhar, gets infuriated after a politician's son throws acid on his sister. However, his life changes when he kills the culprit, whose family later seeks revenge from Devdhar.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் ராமாயணம் கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டா
programme.desc: வால்மீகி ராமாயணத்தின் நான்காவது புத்தகமான 'கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டம்' குறித்து ஒரு சமய அறிஞர் சொற்பொழிவாற்றுகிறார், அதன் அத்தியாயங்கள் ராமர் மற்றும் லட்சுமணன் சீதையைத் தேடுவதை மையமாகக் கொண்டது.

programme.title: சதமானம்பவதி

programme.title: பக்தி கீதா மாலிகா

programme.title: பசுபதிநாத் ஆலயம்
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலய தர்ஷனம்
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கோயில்களின், வரலாறு, கட்டிடக்கலை, புனைவுகள் மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தை ஆராய்ந்து பாருங்கள்.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீ பத்மாவதி அம்மாவாரி கல்யாணம் திருச்சனூர் லைவ்
